If you're using an iPhone 16 or newer, you may be interested in a Qi2.2 charger to take full advantage of the 25W MagSafe charging speeds your phone supports. Anker's new 25W Prime MagSafe 3-in-1 charger is one of the standout options, featuring an excellent portable design.

第一印象

The major trend in the second half of 2025 has been bringing 25W Qi2.2 to every wireless charging accessory, and that wave shows no signs of slowing down into 2026. Anker is leading the charge with a brand-new portable MagSafe 3-in-1 charger that incorporates 25W Qi2.2 support into a highly portable design.

To achieve 25W wireless charging, active cooling is almost a necessity. Nearly every 25W charger on the market comes with a built-in cooling system, and Anker's new foldable 3-in-1 charger is no exception.

The package includes a 45W charging brick and USB-C cable, providing ample power to charge your iPhone, AirPods, and Apple Watch simultaneously. With this desktop charger, you can get your iPhone 18 Pro to 50% in just 27 minutes.

Remember the MagSafe Duo? If you were a fan of that product but Apple later discontinued it, you'll love this new offering. Its portability closely mirrors the MagSafe Duo, but with two major advantages: it can function as a desktop stand, and it can charge three devices at once instead of two.

The charger has a rather cute (though admittedly unnecessary) feature where the Apple Watch charger uses a spring-loaded design. When the charger is folded away, it tucks inward; but when you're ready to unfold it for action, a simple press downward pops it out. I find this design quite thoughtful, and it makes the product's higher price tag feel more justified.

總結

Overall, if you're looking for a high-quality MagSafe 3-in-1 charger that's convenient for travel, Anker's new offering is a solid choice. Thanks to its built-in active cooling, it charges fairly quickly without overheating or experiencing the other negative effects that wireless charging can sometimes produce.

Anker's new 3-in-1 MagSafe charger is now available on Amazon for $99 with Prime shipping, available in black and white.
